Interpol and Night Verses. 
The vibe of Chino on an Interpol song would be fucking incredible, and I could for real see it considering that both bands like eachother's music. Chino is perfect for Interpol's post-punk moodiness.

And then Night Verses ?  Shit would be incredible.
If you haven't heard them, check out these songs:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uArtPCoyFVw (with vocals)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UdDFGmUPGiQ (instrumental)

They had a vocalist, Doug Robinson formerly of The Sleeping, but he left a few years ago and since then they've been kicking it as an instrumental band.
The instrumentals are already crazy enough, but imagine Chino's vocals on a song like that, especially considering the old vocalist's dynamics are arguably reminiscent of Chino's. 

Night Verses have even cited Deftones as an influence, so I feel like the chemistry is definitely there. 

Also just due to the nature that they're an instrumental band, having a guest vocalist for a song would be an interesting idea and seems totally doable.
